## Sale of Land Located in Milton-Freewater, Oregon

In August 2019, the Company sold vacant land located in Milton-Freewater, Oregon, with a net carrying value of $0.3 million, for cash of $0.3 million (net of selling costs of less than $0.1 million). This resulted in a net gain on disposal of property and equipment of less than $0.1 million, which is included in "General and administrative" costs in the accompanying Consolidated Statement of Operations for the year ended December 31, 2019.

## Sale of Fixed Assets, Land and Building Located in Ponca City, Oklahoma
